semantics.literal_rule: Literal argument data remains inert until consumed by the resolved command operation.
semantics.exact_rule: Executable command identity resolves exactly through the command registry.
semantics.family_rule: Intermediate command-family segments are namespaces and are not executed unless separately declared executable.
semantics.error_rule: Unknown command, invalid namespace or invalid argument produces a structured parse/validation error before effects.
semantics.authority_rule: Parsing never grants capability or authority.

invariants.rule: Command parsing, namespace resolution and execution remain explicit; namespace grouping never silently becomes executable behavior.
